title: Ideas inventory stories, relationships, learning and tools tranche
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: partial actual story/relationship/learning/tool crosswalk review; internal supersession and current authority qualified
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual new review covers original391–510: BU6/BZ1–BZ6/CD1–CD5; relationship RLK1–RLK8/RLO1–RLO6/RLR1–RLR7/RLU1–RLU4/RLAI1–RLAI6/RLAD1–RLAD13; learning SLN1–SLN12/SLL1–SLL13 as listed; technology CN3–CN15/MCW5–MCW8; tools TQ52–55/TQ60–64/TQ90–92/TQ199–200; UI ID1–ID7. Together B534–B538 cover original1–510 only. Original511–1169 remains for actual reading. Missing intermediate codes are not implicitly reviewed. Dated supplier locators, source-local IDs, mechanisms and proof limits stay intact.

F2: Story and relationship tables preserve event prerequisites, actual role/cast needs, causal successor edges, supply/stakeholders and downstream deltas. A relationship recognizer reads real receipts; it does not create affection, hostility, fulfilled obligations or witnessed knowledge from a label. Shared authority per fact does not collapse memories, opinions, agreements, contact and different directed relationships into one scalar bond. Genre templates and sparse overrides are proposed authoring tools, not proof every world becomes data-only or that fewer fields mean a correct adaptation. Canon anchors and private locators require the qualified actual source window; a golden Cyoria route or old Discworld-first idea does not change the current developer-world order. Fate/convergence are optional local mechanisms with actual actors/law, not a universal force pulling every deviation back to canon.

F3: Preserve world delta, fresh run, retained life, revision rebase and cross-world carrier as different operations. RLO3's cast-aged/plans-moved-on shorthand applies only where the actual absence policy supports it; AD16 pauses inactive worlds by default. A fresh original life need not start at a franchise canon baseline. Cross-world effects require actual carrier/reach such as travel, remote link, shared actor or carried mechanism, not blanket isolation or automatic spread. RLR6's old request for a save decision is not proof the user owes a new answer now; use the current compatibility owner. RLU4's ban on timeline/branch names is an authoring lint idea, not a prohibition on a world whose real law intentionally uses branch identity. Optional story kits and changed-event proof do not become all-world completion gates.

F4: Content requests, private gap logs, template fallback, offline drafting and evaluated live expression are useful separate ideas. Generic telling is a content-coverage gap, not false physical failure or permission to invent history. A model may propose expression or intent, but existing game owners decide and commit effects. Matching a handful of accepted scenes does not certify every actor/knowledge/agency case; score held-out failures and correction burden under the selected evaluation. No template answer should fabricate a presently unsupported event, and turning a model off must not change already committed function. Author/private truth inspection differs from runtime actor-safe context; neither justifies sending a whole private save. Early-end/park/bookmark, near-end recovery, trial detour and POV interlude retain body/means/carry/clock/return rules and visible content-edge warnings. These are optional proposals, not new punishments, blanket mandatory end warnings or dispatched API readers.

F5: The learning block contains its own supersession. SLL2 teacher-feedback proposal is explicitly replaced by coached SLL7 because lessons already gate practice. SLL7 is historically browser-verified; SLL11 fluency reads executions, and SLL12 plateau replaces a hard drill wall. SLL8's copied state cell says built/unverified but its own later text says the old caps are gone with SLL12, so do not rebuild them from that label. Understanding, fluency, source/faculty and their carriers differ; a teacher may supply means without handing over mastery. Rust stays a local dial, memory take/copy/seal names exact layers, and a new life's retained understanding does not universally force mastery zero. Shared taught records need a useful current consumer under AD51, not a compulsory second implementation. Old no-migration/human-acceptance/1366 phrases stay qualified by AR6, AD42 and current targets.

F6: Technology cues bind the craft-time skill/sense channel and saved evidence rather than introducing current omniscient narration or another save field. Planner unbound-demo status, CN7 blocked and CN10/11 built/unverified are dated extraction labels requiring the actual owner/receipt; this pass supplies no current implementation proof. CN12's79-worktree/32-branch count and named cleanup, CN13 USER_VISION rewrite, CN14 wait-for-acceptance order and CN15 push request are historical, not present deletion/commit/push authority or blockers to documentation work. Current primary-checkout, shared hunk preservation and optional human review apply. Reputation layers, inheritance of quest policy, seasonal fertility and material-derived families remain selected-consumer proposals, not universal economy/progression laws.

F7: Tool TQ62 is expressly superseded by IP1–IP9, with IP1–IP3 source and scoped browser evidence; TQ90 records that delivered subset. Do not create duplicate basic wear/repair, or promote it to proof of all lending, forging fit, diagnosis or typed damage. Instrument content/control profile differs from per-instance condition/holder fit and actual maker snapshot. Technique, tool delivery and energy source remain separate, with source-qualified exceptions rather than a compulsory cost or school-loan outcome. Unknown tool facts stay MEMORY until actual evidence, and narrower current body/holder identity can support a first useful seam without an unrelated universal instance rewrite. ID1–ID7 retain adjacent-to-source placement proposals and wider Compare tradeoffs; B533's complete UI owner and current UR43 supersede the old pending hover-selection claim. No new layout, narrator, tool rule, source study, private-save operation, worker or gameplay is delivered by this tranche.
reviews.evidence: Original391–420,421–450,451–480,481–510 read completely in four bounded outputs. Prior B534–B537 cover1–390. No underlying source book, supplier artifact, runtime, current worktree inventory or private save revalidation.
